```yaml
name: Spellcheck

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  spellcheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Spellcheck
        uses: crate-ci/typos@v1.18.1
        with:
          config: typos.toml
```
